answers.core: This feature would benefit a large portion of 2D game developers who rely on AnimationPlayer for complex animations. Since AnimationPlayer is a fundamental part of Godot, it makes sense to include this functionality directly in the core engine, ensuring consistency and a better out-of-the-box experience for 2D game development. Having it in the core engine would also ensure compatibility across different Godot versions without requiring third-party plugins.
answers.workaround: This can currently be achieved using a plugin (such as the one in [this repository](https://github.com/poohcom1/godot-animated-sprite-2-player)), but having this built into the engine would provide a more seamless and convenient solution, especially for projects with many animated sprites.

title: Include AnimatedSprite to AnimationPlayer conversion functionality in the engine
